feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: in iteration 1, the ±0.03 m span with 12 mm footprints raised s-bend finishes from 5/20 to 16/20 and s-bend steering_oscillation from 0.25 to 0.34, but the slalom stayed at 0/20 with 1.05 line-loss events and max_error 0.064. In iteration 2, the 16 mm footprint gave no slalom gain (0/20, max_error 0.0646) and cut s-bend finishes to 15/20. In iteration 3, lead 0.04 m dropped the oval to 14/20 and the s-bend to 6/20. In iteration 4, wheel_track 0.10 m kept the oval at 20/20 at 1.82 s, but the slalom still lost the line (1.0 events, max_error 0.0619). Footprint and lead are therefore ruled out as the slalom fix, and reach is the remaining suspect. Next-race rules: if slalom line_loss_events fall clearly below 1.0 and max_error drops toward 0.055 to 0.06, keep the span and try a finish-oriented step next. If slalom line loss is unchanged at about 1.0 with max_error still 0.06 or more, the span is not the limit, so return to ±0.03 m and try the lead of 0.07 m. If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 with no slalom gain, return to ±0.03 m with 0.01 m pitch.
